families.title: Importance weighting: support, conditional law and variance
families.boundary: The formal task is finite-sum algebra. Conditional expectation interpretation additionally needs the actual conditional sampling law and predictable losses. No adaptive regret bound is certified.

near_solution.delta: Existing source assumes FiniteActionDistribution (nonnegativity plus normalization); this formal task keeps only normalization and selected nonzero weight. The proof is a near-complete reusable solution. Retrieval/adaptation difficulty is unmeasured.

families.title: Finite-horizon policy evaluation: terminal data and uniqueness
families.boundary: Finite-horizon evaluation of a fixed Markov policy with zero terminal value. This is neither optimal control nor an infinite-horizon contraction theorem. The abstract Lean uniqueness argument does not certify trajectory-return semantics for arbitrary measurable spaces.
